$comment: Hand-edited properties; geometry rebuilt from trace.json by make past (decision 12).

properties.name: Hyde Street Pier
properties.geometry_method: Traced by eye from USGS San Francisco North 1:24,000 (1950) (1 hand-read points).
properties.notes: The pier's slips as the 1950 sheet draws them; the Sausalito slips of 1922 were replaced by one farther north in 1934.

properties.name: Sausalito ferry terminal (Northwestern Pacific)
properties.geometry_method: Traced by eye from USGS San Francisco North 1:24,000 (1950) (1 hand-read points).

sources.note: The ferry company used "the terminal properties of the Northwestern Pacific Railroad Company at Sausalito" (OCR).

properties.notes: The railroad's slips at Sausalito Point, as the 1950 sheet draws them, where today's ferry terminal stands. When they opened and closed isn't sourced yet.

properties.name: Berkeley ferry pier
properties.geometry_method: Traced by eye from USGS Oakland West 1:24,000 (1949) (1 hand-read points).
properties.notes: The end of the auto ferry pier from the foot of University Ave, which the 1949 sheet draws as "Berkeley Pier (abandoned)". When the ferries stopped isn't sourced.
